remarks: Welcome to luxury living in this downtown condo building. This spacious unit boasts an open floor plan with 9 ft ceilings and incredible natural lighting throughout. The kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring GE stainless steel appliances, a gas range, a newer dishwasher and microwave, granite countertops, and a large kitchen island perfect for entertaining. The condo offers 2 large bedrooms and 2 baths, strategically placed on opposite sides of the unit for added privacy. The primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet, an en-suite bath, and sliders leading to a deck. An in-unit washer and dryer provide added convenience.  Building amenities are exceptional, including a well-equipped fitness center, a chic club room, a terrace with grills, concierge services. Additionally, the rental comes with 1 reserved parking spot and 1 guest pass. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy downtown living at its finest!
